about: .title is not read on a plain enum (chapter 3 § 3.4.1). The input note_kind is a plain enum of narrative and table. Invalid: the agent node plan's if reads input.note_kind.title. Valid: input.note_kind.value.
sentences: Node 'plan' reads input.note_kind.title, but string {narrative, table} is a plain enum with no titles; read .value, or give the format oneOf with const and title.
